title: 13. Support Vector Machines (SVM)
description: Maximize margins with linear hyperplanes and utilize the RBF Kernel Trick for complex decision boundaries.

blocks.content:
### Maximizing Margins & The Kernel Trick

Support Vector Machines find the optimal boundary (hyperplane) maximizing the margin between classes.

![Linear SVM Margin & Boundary](/images/ml/chart_linear_svm.png)

#### The RBF Kernel Trick
For nonlinear non-separable data, the **RBF Kernel** projects points into higher dimensions where linear boundaries separate classes cleanly.

![RBF Kernel Decision Boundary](/images/ml/chart_kernel_svm.png)

blocks.question: What are 'Support Vectors' in Support Vector Machines?
options: The data points furthest away from the decision boundary
The closest data points to the decision boundary that determine the margin width and boundary position
The missing values in the dataset
The gradient vectors during gradient descent
blocks.explanation: Support vectors are the data points lying on the margin boundary that directly define the hyperplane placement.
